_doc: Delhi city bus (DTC / cluster) distance slabs. Fares in INR per passenger per bus. Validated against Oct 2026 ONDC e-tickets: see models/metrics/fare_validation.json. Edit here, not in code.
distance_basis: sum of straight-line distances between consecutive stops of the bus's stop pattern
_digital_doc: Every e-ticket in the October data is exactly 90% of the slab fare (4.5 / 9 / 13.5 / 18 / 22.5).

concessions.en: Free travel for women on DTC and cluster buses (pink ticket / Saheli card). Check the current eligibility rules before travelling.
concessions.hi: डीटीसी और क्लस्टर बसों में महिलाओं के लिए मुफ़्त यात्रा (पिंक टिकट / सहेली कार्ड)। यात्रा से पहले मौजूदा पात्रता नियम देख लें।
